claim: With BAR1 P2P enabled on a CMP 170HX, NCCL moves 2-GPU all-reduce traffic over P2P/CUMEM instead of shared memory and same-switch bus bandwidth rises from 3.69 to 4.83 GB/s at 256 MiB.
stance_target: cc-6's committed reading that P2P is a latency lever, not a bandwidth lever, and the corpus claim that a 64 MB BAR1 makes NCCL-over-BAR1-P2P impossible
scope_conditions: 4x CMP 170HX (GA100, SM80), 65,536 MiB each, BAR1 64 GiB each after the memory unlock, Gen2 x16 per card, two PLX PEX 8747 switches on CPU2, dual Xeon E5-2686 v4, 180 W, driver 615.71.09 + upstream cmpunlocker 88e39ce + rebar-serialize.patch + four BAR1-P2P patches from admunch888/cmpunlocker, RMForceStaticBar1=1;RMPcieP2PType=1, torch 2.13.0+cu130 / NCCL 2.29.7, bf16 sum
quoted_support: With P2P on, NCCL moves 2-GPU traffic over `P2P/CUMEM` instead of shared memory: same-switch bus bandwidth rises from 3.7 to 4.8 GB/s.
numbers: 2 GPU SHM 256 MiB: 72,736 us, busbw 3.69 GB/s
2 GPU P2P 256 MiB: 55,536 us, busbw 4.83 GB/s
2 GPU SHM 1 MiB: 393 us, busbw 2.67 GB/s
2 GPU P2P 1 MiB: 317 us, busbw 3.31 GB/s

claim: At three ranks the BAR1-P2P all-reduce is SLOWER than host-staged SHM at 256 MiB (3.86 vs 4.24 GB/s busbw), so the P2P bandwidth gain inverts as rank count rises.
stance_target: cc-6's committed reading that P2P is a latency lever, not a bandwidth lever, for the N>=3 case that the 5-card box actually needs
scope_conditions: same 4x CMP 170HX rig, Gen2 x16, three GPUs with one pair cross-switch, 256 MiB bf16 all-reduce

claim: BAR1 P2P copy bandwidth is worse than host-staged above 16 MiB (5.79 vs 6.27 GB/s at 256 MiB) and only wins on latency at small sizes, so P2P is a latency lever for copies.
stance_target: cc-6's committed 'latency lever, not bandwidth lever' reading
scope_conditions: 4x CMP 170HX, 64 GiB BAR1, Gen2 x16, cuMemcpyPeer 256 MiB with byte verification, median of 30 (<=16 MiB) or 8 copies
quoted_support: **It is a latency win, not a bandwidth win.** Small and medium copies are 1.4-1.8x faster; above 16 MiB the host-staged path is slightly faster (6.27 vs 5.79 GB/s).
numbers: 4 KiB: 22.0 us staged vs 15.8 us P2P (1.39x)
5.79 GB/s P2P vs 6.27 GB/s staged at 256 MiB

claim: On a real tensor-parallel workload (GLM-5.3-Flash TP4, ~100 small collectives per decode step) enabling BAR1 P2P makes decode 25-44% slower: 19.4 ms/step with P2P off vs 26.1 ms with P2P on.
stance_target: cc-6's committed reading that P2P does not help bandwidth-bound collectives on this fabric, and against any recommendation to enable BAR1 P2P for training collectives
scope_conditions: 4x CMP 170HX at Gen2 x16 behind two PLX switches, 180 W, Morrowmake recipe 1.6.0 with DFlash2 drafter, same drafter acceptance (6.69 tokens per step) in every run
quoted_support: Same drafter acceptance (6.69 tokens per step at one user) in every run, so the difference is pure step time: **19.4 ms with P2P off vs 26.1 ms with P2P on**. TP4 decode issues about a hundred small collectives per step; on this host the host-staged all-reduce vLLM selects without P2P is faster than the BAR1 path through the PLX switches.
numbers: 1u structured: 396.0 tok/s P2P off vs 293.4 P2P on

claim: A 64 GiB BAR1 obtained from the memory unlock removes the 64 MB-BAR1 blocker that the aikitoria fork's kbusIsPcieBar1P2PMappingSupported_GH100 check could not pass, and NCCL collectives then run over BAR1 P2P without hanging.
stance_target: the corpus reading that BAR1 P2P hangs every NCCL collective on a 170HX because BAR1 is 64 MB
scope_conditions: CMP 170HX with cmpunlocker memory unlock (BAR1 resized to 64 GiB), static BAR1, RMForceStaticBar1=1, RMPcieP2PType=1, four BAR1-P2P patches from admunch888/cmpunlocker
quoted_support: Each card needs a 64 GiB BAR1 for static-BAR1 P2P. ... Driver: upstream cmpunlocker + rebar-serialize.patch + the four BAR1-P2P patches from admunch888/cmpunlocker (`p2p-caps-override`, `p2p-bar1`, `p2p-skip-mailbox-preinit`, `p2p-readcap-override`), `RMForceStaticBar1=1;RMPcieP2PType=1`.

claim: NCCL all-reduce at 8 KiB is latency-dominated on this fabric: 144 us for 2 GPU SHM, 119 us for 2 GPU P2P, 134 us for 3 GPU SHM, 153 us for 3 GPU P2P, i.e. busbw of 0.06-0.08 GB/s.
stance_target: the small-message regime that tensor parallelism issues per layer, which is why TP is latency-bound on this box
